title: Business Development Manager & Executive
description:
Business Development Manager (BDM) Mandatory Requirements: Candidates must have their own personal laptop and a two-wheeler/four-wheeler for work-related requirements. Applications without both will not be considered. Company: FlairUP
 Location: Vivek Khand 2, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow
 Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO)
 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 Shift Timings: 12:00 PM 09:00 PM (IST) 
 FlairUP is looking for a proactive, confident, and target-driven Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive business growth through lead generation, client acquisition, relationship management, and successful deal closures. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in business development, sales, client handling, negotiations, and managing the complete sales cycle. The candidate should be capable of identifying new business opportunities, building a strong client network, and consistently achieving revenue targets. Key Responsibilities Lead Generation: Identify and generate qualified business leads through networking, market research, references, online platforms, and other relevant channels. Client Acquisition: Identify potential clients, understand their business requirements, present suitable solutions, and convert prospects into long-term clients. Meetings & Deal Closures: Conduct client meetings, deliver business presentations, negotiate commercial terms, and independently close deals. Sales Pipeline Management: Manage the complete sales pipeline, maintain lead databases, track prospects, and ensure consistent follow-ups. Business Development: Explore new markets, identify growth opportunities, and develop strategies to expand the company's client base. Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients to encourage repeat business and referrals. Proposal & Contract Management: Prepare and review business proposals, quotations, pitch presentations, client agreements, and contracts. Market Research: Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments to identify potential business opportunities. Sales Reporting: Maintain regular sales reports, track conversion rates, monitor performance, and provide timely updates to management. Revenue Achievement: Work towards monthly and quarterly sales targets and contribute to the company's overall business growth. Internal Coordination: Collaborate with the marketing and other internal teams to improve lead generation, client communication, and business development activities. Required Skills & Qualifications Proven experience in Business Development, Sales, or Client Acquisition. Strong experience in lead generation, client meetings, negotiations, and deal closures. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong presentation, networking, and relationship management abilities. Ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle. Good understanding of sales pipelines, business proposals, and commercial negotiations. Target-oriented mindset with the ability to achieve revenue goals. Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of business development activities. Preferred Experience Experience working with IT services companies, digital marketing agencies, or other B2B service-based organizations will be preferred. Candidates with an established professional network and experience in acquiring business clients will have an added advantage. Candidates should be comfortable with client meetings and business development activities. Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@flairup.in.

Key Skills: Office,Business development,IT sales,Sales,Advertising,Presales,B2B Sales,Enterprise
